The first five terms of a series formed using grey hexagons and white diamonds are given below. If the same pattern continues, how many diamonds will be present in the term where the number of hexagons is 144?
a) 100
b) 135
c) 121
d) 169
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Translator
turn words into numbers, pictures or steps
Make a table: term 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, with the number of hexagons and of diamonds in each.
Roots
ask why it works
Ask why the counts grow that way. The hexagons make a square, n by n. What size of square do the diamonds make?

Given below are two sets of numbers, P and Q. Which number from Set P can be interchanged with a number from Set Q such that both new sets follow a particular series or pattern?
Set P: (18, 22, 24, 27, 30)
Set Q: (21, 24, 27, 31, 36)
a) 18
b) 27
c) 22
d) 30
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Starter
decide how to begin
Begin with Set P: most of it goes up by the same step. Which number breaks that step?
Slicer
break it into small parts
Then check Set Q. Which of its numbers would fill the gap in P? Does Q still follow a pattern after the swap?
YOUR TURN
Name the number from Set P that should move.
